title.en: Ariviyal Ketkiratha en Kural! (அறிவியல் கேட்கிறதா என் குரல்!)

text.en: Can anyone hear nature crying out about polluted air?

This unit's learning goals include reading news about air pollution and discussing it, and enjoying Sangam songs and new poems that picture nature. The lesson raises the alarm about environmental damage and asks whether our voice is heard.
It teaches that science should be used to protect nature, and that every person is responsible for reducing pollution.
Terms: காற்று மாசுபாடு (air pollution), சுற்றுச்சூழல் (environment), அறிவியல் (science) and பாதுகாப்பு (protection).
